notes: יוֹם carries no article morpheme, so the 'the' before 'time' is a supplied determiner joining the noun under rule 15, and the attributive אַחֲרוֹן takes the phrase 'to come', headed on the lexeme-bearing word under rule 31.
The copula joins the nominal predicate לְבוּשׁ under rule 20, discontinuous around the possessive under rule 25.
